originalPassage: Many people take the commonsense view that color is an objective property of things, or of the light that bounces off them. They say a tree's leaves are green because they reflect green light - a greenness that is just as real as the leaves. Others argue that color doesn't inhabit the physical world at all but exists only in the eye or mind of the viewer. They maintain that if a tree fell in a forest and no one was there to see it, its leaves would be colorless - and so would everything else. They say there is no such thing as color; there are only the people who see it. Both positions are, in a way, correct. Color is objective and subjective - "the place," as Paul Cézanne put it, "where our brain and the universe meet." Color is created when light from the world is registered by the eyes and interpreted by the brain.

question.direction: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

markedExpressions.label: (A)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: color is an objective property of things, or of the light that bounces off them.

markedExpressions.label: (B)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: They say a tree's leaves are green because they reflect green light

markedExpressions.label: (C)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: Others argue that color doesn't inhabit the physical world at all but exists only in the eye or mind of the viewer.

markedExpressions.label: (D)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: They say there is no such thing as color; there are only the people who see it.

markedExpressions.label: (E)
markedExpressions.surroundingText: Color is created when light from the world is registered by the eyes and interpreted by the brain.

wrongOptionExplanations.(A): 'the light'를 선행사로 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 that은 어법상 올바릅니다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(B): 주어 'they'(a tree's leaves)에 맞춰 복수 동사 reflect가 쓰인 것은 적절합니다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(C): not A but B 구조에서 doesn't inhabit과 병렬을 이루어 3인칭 단수 주어 color에 맞춘 단수 동사 exists는 맞습니다.
wrongOptionExplanations.(E): is registered와 등위접속사 and로 연결되어 과거분사 interpreted가 사용된 것은 수동의 의미로 올바릅니다.

question.explanation: (D) "is"는 어법상 틀린 표현이며 "are"로 고쳐야 한다. 정답 문장의 골격을 살펴보면 'there are only the people who see it'에서 유도부사 there 뒤에 오는 주어는 복수명사인 'the people'입니다. 주어가 복수이므로 동사는 복수형태가 와야 합니다. 따라서 단수 동사 is는 비문이며, 이를 복수 동사 are로 고쳐야 합니다. 학생들은 'there'에 시선을 빼앗겨 바로 뒤의 주어를 확인하지 않고 단수 동사로 착각할 수 있으므로 주의해야 합니다.
keyPoints: (E) 능동태 vs 수동태 — 병렬에 따른 과거분사
